#1 In the page for Traced Monoidal Categories, I believe the types for the "tightening" axiom are a bit off. Specifically

g:A→B, f:B⊗X→C⊗X, h:C→D

should have the types for g and h swapped, or swap those arrows in the axiom. If you write out the commutative diagrams, this becomes apparent. I do not feel qualified to change any nLab pages myself.
